title: SVG
tagline: Draw, structure, and control graphics for the web
summary: SVG is the web's native language for scalable vector graphics. This book takes you from the SVG document model and coordinate systems through shapes, paths, curves, gradients, transforms, text, masks, filters, animation, interaction, accessibility, optimization, and programmatic SVG generation. By the end you'll understand SVG as a structured graphics system rather than just a collection of drawing commands.
